messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing.metering.token_anomaly in eu-central (P2). Token counts spiking ~+18% vs baseline; automated overage flags triggered for several small tenants. alert: https://alerts.redwood/7991122334
oncall: ack. joining. Which tenants are showing flags? Any customer pages yet?
prod-alerts: sent automated overage notices to tenants: tenant_7f, tenant_2b, tenant_x17 at 12:08 UTC. Hold further notifications?
billing-eng: seeing duplicate event ids in the usage stream. pattern: same message_id appears with different kafka offset pairs (replay). suspect consumer restart causing at-least-once reprocessing.
kafka-ingest: consumer autoscaler restarted group eu-central-consumers at ~12:05; offset commit race occurred when pods terminated before committing. that allowed replays when they came up.
oncall: okay, temporary mitigation: pause outbound overage notifications and create CS template. @cs-lead please prepare comms.
cs-lead: on it. draft will say: "We detected incorrect temporary overage indicators due to internal processing replays. We are reconciling and will remove any erroneous charges." cc billing.
ops: pausing customer notifications now :white_check_mark: (prod-alerts muted)
prod-alerts: mute confirmed. silenced: billing.overage eu-central channel
billing-eng: quick investigative query: 
```
SELECT msg_id, count(*) as occurrences, min(offset), max(offset)
FROM raw_kafka.usage
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-21T11:50:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-21T12:20:00Z'
GROUP BY msg_id
HAVING occurrences > 1
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

billing-eng: results: ~4.2k duplicate msg_ids, mostly from topic usage-eu-central-partition-3.
kafka-ingest: deploying an offset-fence hotfix to the consumer library to avoid reprocessing during preStop. rolling update started (canary 1/6).
maya: can we run a shadow-agg compare for effected tenants once hotfix is live? want to ensure counts align before unmuting alerts.
billing-eng: yes. plan: 1) stop replays (hotfix) 2) run dedupe job to mark duplicates and reduce counts 3) compare against shadow_agg snapshot 4) restore notifications & notify customers.
ops: canary applied, no new duplicates on canary node. proceeding with controlled rolling update.
incident-bot: metrics snapshot: token_rate +17.9% baseline; kafka.dup_rate +12%; consumer.group_lag eu-central-consumers=95k
kafka-ingest: rolling update 3/6 in progress. will stream logs to #eng-runtime.
billing-eng: kicking off dedupe backfill for window 11:55-12:25, estimated runtime 9m. command:
```
./tools/dedupe_backfill --topic usage-eu-central --start 2026-03-21T11:55:00Z --end 2026-03-21T12:25:00Z --mark-duplicates
```

cs-lead: draft ready. Suggest offering one-time credit if customer actually billed for overage; keep wording conservative.
oncall: agree. please hold off on sending until we have corrected numbers.
incident-bot: dedupe job started at 7991122385.
billing-eng: progress: dedupe found 4,218 duplicates; net reduction -9,800 tokens across affected tenants so far.
ops: rolling update completed 6/6. no further duplicate emissions observed in live stream.
kafka-ingest: consumer lag back to normal ranges ~2k.
prod-alerts: still muted pending final reconciliation.
billing-eng: running shadow compare for sample tenants (tenant_7f, tenant_2b, tenant_x17). query:
```
SELECT t.tenant_id, sum(t.reported_tokens) as reported, s.shadow_total as shadow
FROM billing.reports t JOIN analytics.shadow_agg s USING (tenant_id)
WHERE t.tenant_id IN ('tenant_7f','tenant_2b','tenant_x17') AND t.window = '2026-03-21T12:00:00Z'
GROUP BY t.tenant_id, s.shadow_total;
```

billing-eng: sample diff: tenant_7f: +2 tokens, tenant_2b: -34 tokens, tenant_x17: -1,234 tokens (duplicates removed). overall no material overcharge.
cs-lead: ready to send customer note: will explain root cause (consumer restart + offset race), summarize impact (temporary, small subset, no long-term charges), and offer credit if invoice shows overage.
oncall: send when ready. ops/alerts, unmute after CS send.
cs-lead: sent messages to affected tenants at 12:42 UTC. content includes next steps and contact link.
prod-alerts: unmuting now per ops go-ahead :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: final snapshot: token_rate +0.8% baseline; dup_rate ~0%; consumer_lag normal.
billing-eng: post-run audit confirms corrected counts, no invoices generated for the spurious counts. will keep increased monitoring over next 24h.
oncall: putting incident in monitoring state; will close in 1 hour if stable. thanks for quick turnaround.
maya: nice work all.
ops: thumbs up :thumbsup:
